bootstrap: 10000 workload resamples seed 20261011 of geometric mean ratio; cluster-by-task sensitivity descriptive
censoring: No replacement after freeze; timeouts and process failures are reported, never counted as wins
exactness_gate: 0 unexplained stdout or exit-code mismatches in any scored pair; no silent workload exclusions
lifecycle: fresh per-invocation index/cache; packaged default capture included
performance_gate: median eligible reduction >=10%; >half eligible faster; geometric bootstrap 95% upper bound <1; leave-two-largest-wins-out median still <1
scientific_question: Does packaged RC 0.2.0rc1 accelerate admitted read-heavy control workloads after fresh per-invocation setup?
stop: All selected workloads, 3 scored repetitions per arm; no outcome-driven rerun or RC change; research ends after verdict

verdict_mapping.EXPERIMENT_INCONCLUSIVE: identity, measurement, or environment failure prevents valid paired endpoint
verdict_mapping.NO_MATERIAL_RC_ACCELERATION: exactness passes but no material eligible workload effect and no clear fast-path-only evidence
verdict_mapping.RC_ACCELERATION_CLAIM_SUPPORTED: exactness and performance gates pass with actual contact >0
verdict_mapping.RC_ACCELERATION_SUPPORTED_NARROWLY: exactness passes, performance gate fails overall, but preregistered subset workbook>=1000000 bytes and static_read_events>=10 has median reduction>=10%, >half faster, and bootstrap upper<1
verdict_mapping.RC_FASTPATH_ONLY_PRODUCT_SPEED_NOT_SUPPO: exactness passes; acceleration contacts occur and per-operation telemetry shows faster reads but eligible total-invocation median reduction <10%

workload_statistic: median of 3 scored external wall timings per arm
